A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Bevoegdheidstoedeling.title: Bevoegdheidstoedeling
Bevoegdheidstoedeling.description: A bevoegdheidstoedeling: a record of who may exercise which authority on whose behalf, delegatie, mandaat, volmacht, or machtiging (Awb afdeling 10.1.1/10.1.2, BW Boek 3 titel 3). It stores the delegans/mandaatgever and the delegataris/gemandateerde (as a body, a function description, and/or a person), the scope (onderwerp) and its limits (financieelPlafond, beperkingen), the wettelijke grondslag, a trace to the authorizing delegatie-/mandaatbesluit (Decision) and, on intrekking, the revoking Decision, a validity window (geldigVanaf/geldigTot), an ondermandaat parent link, a declarative status lifecycle (ADR-031), declarative expiry rappels, and a live public delegatie- en mandaatregister via the OpenRegister published-predicate. The register documents authority; it never enforces it. It stores relations, not documents: publication of the delegatiebesluit text itself (CVDR/DROP) belongs to the verordeningenregister capability. CONSTRAINT (design D4): this schema contains ONLY publishable fields by construction (no internal-only / confidential-remark property; internal working notes live in the sidebar audit trail; delegataris persons are governance persons already public in the people register; function descriptions are organisational facts). Adding ANY non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design in D4, because the whole live object is exposed through the public-group authorization.read rule when publicationDate <= $now.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-DMR-002). Canonical dialect verbatim from the sibling fragments (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). concept → van-kracht → ingetrokken | vervallen; ingetrokken and vervallen terminal. ingetrokken is an explicit intrekking (the UI action stores the revoking Decision in ingetrokkenDoor in the same save); vervallen records lapse by time (geldigTot passed) or by the underlying besluit expiring, without a revoking decision. No app-side state machine.

bevoegdheidExpiry60._note: Pre-expiry rappel at ~60 days (REQ-DMR-007). intervalSec 5184000 (~60 days) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — griffie-configurable tuning deferred). Filter targets status van-kracht only, so no notification fires for concept/ingetrokken/vervallen or for a toedeling without geldigTot; the 'geldigTot within window' comparison is carried by the scheduled engine's window semantics, which the simple filter shape cannot express as a date comparison — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as 60-day/14-day before-expiry rappels during live import.

bevoegdheidExpiry14._note: Pre-expiry rappel at ~14 days (REQ-DMR-007). intervalSec 1209600 (~14 days) is PROVISIONAL. Filters status van-kracht so no notification fires for terminal or open-ended (no geldigTot) toedelingen. Same window-semantics caveat as bevoegdheidExpiry60. Recipients approximate 'the responsible staff group' via object-acl (read) + decidesk-members group.

type.title: Type
type.description: The nature of the authority assignment (Awb/BW). Required.

delegans.title: Delegans
delegans.description: Reference to the delegans / mandaatgever as a GovernanceBody (the authority that assigns). At least one of delegans or delegansOmschrijving MUST be present (schema-level anyOf).

delegansDescription.title: Delegans description
delegansDescription.description: The delegans / mandaatgever as a role description where it is an eenhoofdig bestuursorgaan or not a GovernanceBody in this deployment (e.g. 'burgemeester', 'gemeentesecretaris'). At least one of delegans or delegansOmschrijving MUST be present.

delegatarisBody.title: Delegataris (body)
delegatarisBody.description: Reference to the delegataris / gemandateerde as a GovernanceBody. At least one of delegatarisBody, delegatarisFunctie, or delegatarisPersoon MUST be present (schema-level anyOf).

delegateRole.title: Delegataris (function)
delegateRole.description: The delegataris / gemandateerde as a plain-text function/role description (e.g. 'afdelingshoofd Samenleving', 'teamleider Inkoop'). Plain text by design. HR/formatie management is out of scope so personnel churn never invalidates the register. At least one delegataris field MUST be present.

delegatePerson.title: Delegataris (person)
delegatePerson.description: Reference to the delegataris / gemandateerde as a Popolo Person, where the authority is assigned to a named natural person. At least one delegataris field MUST be present.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject / scope of the assigned authority (what may be exercised). Required.
subject.example: Beslissen op subsidieaanvragen tot het genoemde plafond

financialCeiling.title: Financial ceiling
financialCeiling.description: Optional monetary ceiling on the assigned authority (amount in euro).

beperkingen.title: Constraints
beperkingen.description: Optional subject constraints / conditions on the assigned authority.

subMandatePermitted.title: Ondermandaat allowed
subMandatePermitted.description: Whether ondermandaat (a further sub-assignment under this toedeling) is permitted. A child toedeling MAY reference this one via parentToedeling only when this flag is true: enforced server-side on save by OndermandaatGuardService (Tasks 3, imperative), not by a schema constraint.

statutoryBasis.title: Legal basis
statutoryBasis.description: Legal-basis citations for the assignment (same citation vocabulary as the verordeningenregister capability, e.g. 'Awb art. 10:3').

decision.title: Authorizing decision
decision.description: Required reference to the authorizing delegatie-/mandaatbesluit (Decision). The besluit document itself (routes, content, publication) stays entirely in decision-management; this register holds only the relation the besluit establishes.

parentAllocation.title: Parent toedeling
parentAllocation.description: Optional self-reference to the parent toedeling this one is an ondermandaat of (hoofdmandaat = no parent, depth 0). Accepted only when the parent exists and has ondermandaatToegestaan true, and only when the ancestor chain stays acyclic: both enforced server-side, fail-closed, by OndermandaatGuardService (Tasks 3, imperative; cross-object graph validation is not expressible as a schema constraint). Depth is displayed by walking the loaded chain, never stored.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: Date from which the toedeling is valid. Required. Drives the 'geldig op' in-force-on-date register view.

validTo.title: Valid until
validTo.description: Optional date until which the toedeling is valid. Empty means open-ended. Drives the declarative expiry rappels and the 'geldig op' view; a toedeling without geldigTot never triggers an expiry notification.

withdrawnBy.title: Revoked by
withdrawnBy.description: Optional reference to the revoking Decision (intrekkingsbesluit). Set together with the transition to status ingetrokken in the same save, so every ingetrokken toedeling traces to the besluit that revoked it. Absent for a vervallen lapse.

status.title: Status
status.description: Assignment status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): concept → van-kracht → ingetrokken | vervallen. ingetrokken and vervallen are terminal. Transitioning to ingetrokken SHOULD carry an ingetrokkenDoor reference.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live toedeling is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publish is an explicit staff action; because the predicate sits on the live object the public register reflects status changes (an intrekking, a vervallen lapse) without republication (design D4).

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the toedeling is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.
